notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Quarry Hauler and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Quarry Hauler and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Quarry Hauler triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Quarry Hauler trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Quarry Hauler and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
